plugin.name: ob-theme
plugin._long: Owns the single openbox (themerc) theme instance shared by ob-decor, ob-menu and ob-switcher. Load it first for deterministic theming; consumers also work without it (lazy fallback).

option.name: theme_name
option._long: Openbox theme searched in ~/.themes and XDG data dirs (labwc semantics). Empty falls back to ob-decor/theme, then built-in defaults.

option.name: font
option._long: Pango font description used when the per-place fonts below are empty. Empty inherits the libobtheme default (sans 10).

option.name: font_osd
option._long: Pango font for switcher/menu OSD text (labwc <font place="OSD"> spirit). Empty inherits ob-theme/font.
